review_description: Easy to deal with, prompt responses to questions. Installation was quick and painless

A 16kWh SigEnergy battery was added to my existing roof top SolarInstallation were the same crew who installed the solar system.From the first discussion to final commissioning Empower and team were on top of everything.Big thanks to Lindsey in the office and Juan and his team

The sales rep was very helpful. I explained my needs as I wanted full 3 phase backup. His design was excellent.Installation was on time, tidy and was very quick with a team of young men that worked with care.The install was very professional.

I contacted Lindsey via Empower's website, and we corresponded via email and phone and worked through the proposal. My son and I reviewed the technical aspects of a number of quotes and based on Lindsey's support and service, and what we considered to be the best technical outcome, we selected Empower to provide our solar panel and storage package.  The installation was of a very high standard, and the team on site was fantastic-they took us through the system after completing the installation which was really good.Without hesitation, I would use Empower again.

Our solar panel and battery installation with Empower Solar has just been completed, and we couldn’t be happier with the entire experience.From the very beginning, our Energy Consultant, Lindsey Ditfort, has been nothing short of incredible. She took the time to clearly explain every detail of the process in a way that was easy to understand – which was invaluable for someone like me with little prior knowledge. Unlike other companies we had spoken to, Lindsey never pressured us with constant calls or demands for a deposit. Instead, she was patient, approachable, and always willing to answer our many follow-up questions – often spending 20–30 minutes on the phone to ensure we felt confident and well-informed.The installation itself was smooth and well-communicated. The solar panel team was excellent to deal with, working with us to determine the best location and placement for the panels on our roof. The battery installation was delayed due to the state government’s rebate approval process, but throughout that time Lindsey kept us fully updated, regularly checking in and providing honest, timely communication.What truly impressed us was Empower Solar’s commitment to customer satisfaction. When the government rebate delays dragged on, they made the decision to bypass the rebate altogether so that our battery could be installed sooner. Even better, they reduced our quote to match the rebate amount, meaning no additional out-of-pocket expense for us. That level of integrity and customer-first service is rare to find.The battery has now been installed, and we are absolutely thrilled. There was a small issue with minor water damage caused by an unexpected downpour during installation, but even that has been handled seamlessly and without stress on our end.We couldn’t recommend Lindsey Ditfort and Empower Solar highly enough. If you’re looking for a professional, honest, and customer-focused solar company, they are the team to choose.

7.65kW solar panel with 32kWh Sigenergy battery installed 2 days ago.  Since the next morning we havent imported any grid power.  the installation went smoothly and the installers cleared up all their mess.  Highly recommended

Our new solar battery system through Empower is now up and running. From the get-go of enquiries, purchase, installation to operation we have experienced exceptional professionalism and customer service from all the Empower staff and installation contractor.Highly recommend Empower with a BIG shout out to Lindsey from quoting & sales for her 'above and beyond' approach to the highest standard of customer service. The lads from the installation team ensured effective communications throughout the install and cleaned up to expected standards and removed rubbish from site.Overall at each level of the process we were pleased with the service we received and the constant communication and progress streamlined with excellent integration with the energy supplier, application and approval processes. After the sales, it was almost sit back and enjoy the ride. Thank you for such a hassle free experience.Keep up the great work team and we look forward to the benefits of our new system. Thanks Empower Team.

Empower Australia were really easy to deal with from the initial conversation to receiving quotes for various combinations/systems to the installation and connection.  The installers were punctual, polite, helpful, tidy and connection to the grid was organised by Empower.
Great customer service. Quick installation. Panel installers could have been more professional. System seems to running well - just waiting for a smart meter to be installed.

Fantastci service from the momemt we first made contact to the follow up.Installer arrived promptly and completed the work as promised.Explained everythingThey replace tiles damaged by my previous solar installerSo thank you Empower

Requested a quote from 3 different companies and went with these guys, everything was explained to me in a way I could understand and the installation went smoothly. A special mention to Lindsey Ditfort from the Perth office for all of her insight - such a cheerful and helpful lady!

I couldn't be more satisfied with my experience with Empower Solar. From the very beginning, they demonstrated exceptional expertise in understanding my specific needs, particularly considering my electric vehicle ownership and its impact on my household power requirements.What truly sets them apart is their consultative approach. The team took the time to analyse my home's unique characteristics and power utility setup, creating a custom solar and battery solution that perfectly matches our energy consumption patterns. They considered every detail, from our daily usage to future scalability needs.The installation process was remarkably smooth. Their team navigated the inspection process seamlessly, and despite the various challenges specific to my house's configuration, they completed the installation without any complications. Their attention to detail and professional workmanship were evident throughout the entire process.Their comprehensive understanding of both solar technology and local utility requirements made the whole experience stress-free. The system they installed performs exactly as promised, meeting all our power needs efficiently.I highly recommend Empower Solar to anyone considering a solar and battery installation. Their expertise, professionalism, and customer-focused approach are outstanding. Should I need any additional solar installations or upgrades in the future, they will absolutely be my first choice.Pros:- Excellent needs assessment and customisation- Seamless inspection and installation process- Deep understanding of EV power requirements- Professional and knowledgeable team- Outstanding customer serviceOverall: Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable, professional solar installation company that truly understands their customers' needs.

The solar company was equally the best price for the quailty of system selected. Difference came down to the information explained and the responsiveness of the company. I was kept upto date on the process and the install itself was professionally completed again with good communication from the installer. Price paid included the removal and disposal of a previous smaller system. I Would recommend Empower Solar.

These guys were amazing with their customer service. They were prompt and quick in handling my questions and compromised their pricing just to get my business that day. I highly recommend Michael from their team as he will go the distance to get you what you need and ensure the after-sales service is there as well.Thank you ESA Team!

Empower had my solar and battery system installed,  dealing with Justin was easy, his response was always prompt and took the time to meet me at their offices to talk thru some of my questions.The installation was great, about 6 individuals turned up and got the system up and running in one day, including removing the old 5kw system.The installers didn't talk me through the system,  explaining the basics only, which I knew from my research,  a minor issue is still to be resolved so I'm hoping Empower will be prompt.
Quoting easy process, polite the whole team went above and beyond but Justin was amazing & Michael was wonderfulCole the installer did the hard yards and did a amazing jobI'm So grateful
Very reasonable pricing with wonderful customer service.Installation was done promptly and professionally.Very satisfied with the whole thing!
No fuss install. All questions answered quickly. Highly recommend them

The initial person who gave me the quote was excellent. Every question I put to him he answered correctly as I found with my own followup. He also suggested a better Synergy plan for me to benefit more from the use of solar and Tesla battery. the installation was done efficiently and within the time frame given.One hiccup was that I was quoted for the battery which showed the Tesla rebate of $750 and also a voucher from ESA for $150. Tesla has paid their rebate, but even after four phone calls to ESA the voucher is missing in action. Not good PR or business. I will follow up further via emails to see if I get a positive response.

I was excited at getting a new solar system with batteries for backup the sales process was good installation went great until the end and the battery controller head did not work. After a few phone calls to the office by the installers they fobbed me off said everything was ok and they would be back by end of the week with new head for batteries and couldn’t get out of there quick enough.I made one bad mistake I paid up front the day before installation now they are putting me off and saying it will be another week maybe to get it goingEffectively a nine or more day installation period it took 4 phone calls to get a receipt for payment and the monitoring app  sent to me I still dont have any warranty paperwork.  to say I am disappointed  is an understatement  and to be repeatedly given stock standard  stalling  answers to my concerns is treating me as a fool. The inverter and panels work well as expected very pleased with them
Empower was miles ahead on customer service before and after the quote!  Installation is great and the system suits our needs perfectly!!
Good experience overall - system performing well so far with great user interface

Very easy quoting process, impressed with the sales person who took time to visit and appraise the system required and install process.The installation teams (yes two came to speed up the job, were utterly fantastic! They worked well together, were respectful of each other and meshed perfectly to get everything done in record time.Cleaned up everything and removed old system.Very, very impressive- thanks teams!
Very professional, polite and friendly from the sales rep to the installers. Very happy with the service and product.
Quotation, Finance and install n connection all organized  with-in 2 weeks...Customer service A1, Installers service A1...Solar system  output is beyond my expectations..
Quotation, Finance and install all done with-in 2 weeks...Customer service A1, Installers service A1...Solar system  output is beyond my expectations..

Up front our contact was super easy to communicate with, get information from and ask for a requote.I was also very pleasantly surprised with the short turn around from deposit to installation - 12 days.Installation itself was very punctual, clean and the guys were easy to talk to as well.   And despite our solid concrete garage ceiling the guys found a way to get to the RCD box without additional conduit - amazing job.All up a great experience.
Salesperson was very honest and transparent and answered all my questions. Installation was done on the planned day. Everything was setup for me within a few days.

The quoting process was really good, the customer service was excellent, no pressure was put on us at all, the installation was on time and the technicians were very polite, cleaned up after themselves, and Empower helped organise the grid connection.

The pre-sales service was good. Empower took the time to discuss my needs with me and offered something that exactly matched my requirements. They installed it promptly, sooner than I expected. The installation on site was fast, neat and efficient. The installed system fully meets my expectations.
Responsive great customer service clear explanation of  the system and  its operationQuick to install

Great service and professionalism throughout the entire process of initial consolation to installation. Highly recommended.Only thing was there were no instructions given on how to download the app and using it. Being a little tech savvy I was able to resolve that on my own. It would be great to have an email to inform customers on the installation of app and its usage.

Jake was fantastic with his high knowledge about solar and you’re productHe helped me through the whole process sensationallyThe installers were fantastic the guy in charge (I can’t remember his name) was great he explained everything he was doing and installed the app and got it going for me and explained how it workedI would highly recommend empower solar

From quote to installation all personnel involved in the process operated in a professional and helpful manner. It was a pleasure to work with Empower Solar Australia. I would have no hesitation recommending this company.

From the start I had Joshua assisting me with quotes and lots of questions. He was very patient and helpful. Install with Alex and his assistant (sorry I can't remember your name) very helpfull also with questions about where to locate inverter and battery in the garage. Day of install was good, very smooth process, nice people to chat with, polite, cleaned up after they were done, arrived on day and time they said they would.Thankyou, very happy with my panels, inverter and battery. Is great to be running off grid.
Quoting process was good.Installation went off seamlessly.Grid Connection and Phone App all done

EPS got our business even though they were a lot more expensive than the other as they were prompt and followed up. The others took too long to contact me and I had to follow one up to get the quote.We went with EPS as we worried that if the others were so disorganised in even quoting, they may be the same on the installation.
The senior energy consultant, Jason was really patience and friendly while introducing the product, quoting as well as answering our questions. The installers were efficient and tidy.
Salesman - good/quote acceptableInstaller - very good, punctual etcCustomer Service - questionable, took too long from time of accepting the quote to getting the installation done.

From our initial home visit by Empower Solar Perth to commissioning of the units was seamless with good communication and follow up as required. The quote seemed fair and reasonable and workmanship standards were high

The whole experience was seamless from first contact to installation. Professional advice where all the information I required was provided. Been using the resource for almost 45 months and very happy with the addition to our home and the reduction in running costs.

Couldn't fault Empower. The installers were very professional from start to finish, with 1 installer singing along with the music from their radio the whole time they were here. Will be recommending Empower to all of my family, friends and colleagues. Thanks so much, can't wait to see our savings.
Sale process was done very quickly.Install was completed quickly and they were very helpful.Only a minor issue with connection which was sorted out quickly.
No pushy, good info, excellent communication, friendly and tidy installers

The sales / quoting process was simple, very straight forward and a no brainer in the end. Great people to talk to if you have further questions. Installation was completed over 2 days. Old system removed and new panels installed on the first day and battery and inverter installed on the second day. Installers were punctual and informative. The install is very neat and tidy. Even paid a visit to the warehouse prior to installation to see the products first hand. All I had to do was sign the paperwork and pay the deposit. Everything else was taken care of on my behalf.
Great customer service and a great price on a 6.6 kw system.

With the new 8 cent daytime tariff in WA, a home battery became worthwhile.  Technology is important and most suppliers quoted impractical solutions that wasted money and reduced the efficiency of my existing solar panels.  I ended up with a state of the art hybrid inverter and expandable battery system that was rated #1 in Australia.

Got 4 quotes. Empower were the cheapest,  for the exact same make and model of panels and inverter.  Salesman Michael was very knowledgeable,  took the time to run me through it and had an answer to every question I had.No problems or bs with the installation,  was done in half a day.Install was 28 July 2022Attached photo can see the changes in usage, this was in winter during a period of heavy rain.
Great service from A to Z. Someone in the company always provided me with an answer to all my questions. Very efficient , polite and clean installers.

I'm very pleased with my experience with Empower Solar Perth. The sales person had a high degree of technical knowledge and was also very friendly and helpful. The installation was carried out within a few weeks as soon as approval came through and everything was left clean and tidy afterwards.
Empower provided a number of alternate designs, fully developed with information on each, a recommendation and an easy to understand discussion about the options.

We engaged Empower to install our solar of a more recent house purchase. Having used solar on our previous properties we have a reasonable understanding and expectation of what constitutes good service.We felt we were let down by a drop in communication regarding our install from initially setting the date for the install where I was required to chase your reception staff to set the dates, to receive the instructions on how to use the system 5wks post install. I also had to chase your staff to gather the login details to monitor the system as this wasn't provided initially. Ok, we all get busy and sometimes things don't go as efficiently as we like, I get it. However when you asked for a 5 star review (not a review) I gave you a 3. Your manager called to complain to me that I have given you your lowest score, and then spoke about either offering me a $50 voucher for a 5star review, or to have a review of our energy use to in order to optimise the system.  I thought learning to optimise the system would be a good way to make amends, however, we don't have the correct meter reading to give empower access to monitor, apparently synergy is being lazy in this?? I don't know if that is true, I contacted synergy and was told multiple times that the issue is the meter not a lack of knowledge nor trying to pull the wool. To be honest, I am more likely to trust synergies response in this instance.I get tired of playing the pass the buck game and it's certainly not helpful in winning me over.In the end, empower were not able to come to an appropriate solution other than read how many amps our washing machine and dishwasher use & don't run them at the same time... Ok.I am disappointed that I received a mediocre service, and more so that you buy your reviews.I'm sure you guys will learn & grow from this. All the best
Referred by a friend & didn't disappoint. Expertise, competitive pricing and kept well informed all the way from start to finish. Could not recommend Empower more highly. thanks team.

Through out the process customer service was outstanding! I was very grateful to know Don before hand so i went straight to him to get help with my solar. Ofc spending alot of money on something like most people i did my research on what i wanted. I told Don the brand i wanted. He also offer me other brands and explained deep into why. Not being like other sales rep he wasn’t pushy or making me get something i didn’t want. He even price matched other company that was giving me quotes aswell!Installing was on time. Everything went looks neat and most importantly didn’t get complaints from our neighbors.Thanks again to Don and his team for looking after us and we are looking forward to seeing how much we will be saving going on in future.

My system went off line after a power shortage. Within minutes of my call I had a return call from the sales rep, who had arranged the initial installation. I was given specific instruction to correct the problem and provide data to assess any next step that might be required. My system was back on line and working within 10 minutes of my call. The initial installation was seamless and well organised and the service I received today was friendly, efficient and very prompt, just as they claimed it would be.

Michael from Empower was the first to respond. He was proactive, and had looked at the roof on "NearMaps" and already decided where the panels should go. He factored in effect of shadows from neighbouring houses and vent pipes. He arranged a visit quickly and took time to answer all my questions (I'm and engineer, so there were lots). He agreed to install before Christmas which was critical for me to get the Gov't subsidy. Installers came at the date and time agreed and were very professional. System performs as expected. So far so good.

I engaged Empower Solar Perth to install  6.6kW of Aleo panels, a 10kWh Senec home battery/hybrid inverter and a Zappi EV charger on October 2021. Overall, a very professional operation. Michael, my contact at Empower was knowledgeable and able to answer my many questions on my requirements for non Chinese made equipment,  plus making sure this equipment would integrate with the Zappi EV charger.  The installers were very efficient and tidy. A couple of minor integration issues after installation were resolved promptly.Very pleased with our setup, and more than happy to recommend them to all.

Sales quote process was informative not pressured,.Installation was done well with full consultation re our wishes regarding positioning and decommissioning of the old solar system.Customer service was good they dealt with synergy.

Sales quoting process was honest and fair. Had some shading issues and they made it clear which system was required to maximise the return on investment. Installation was slightly more complex and had some hiccups due to the Solaredge monitoring system but these were resolved within a week.

I had a really good experience with Empower.  I had spent a lot of time debating on how to get the best value system. I’d talked to a few cowboys who could do it cheaper but when they saw my roof they refused.Empower never commented on my raked roof. They just did it without a fuss, and my system works beautifully. Definitely worth choosing a company that has stood the test of time.I am confident that if I ever had any issues, they would be there to help straight away.The installers were really great; very polite and professional.

Lovely young fellow quoted.The installation was fabulous and the guys were extremely tidy and only needed 2 tiles to replace.It's been great watching my inverter generating usually between 3000-4500kw.Using my electrical stuff during the day whilst it's generating but not all electrical at once ie not dishwasher   aircon oven washing machine on all at the same time. Dying to see my next bill.
All the processes are very smooth and communication are easy. Highly recommand!

We had a great experience with empower solar who were very professional and communicated very clearly. Kimba was so helpful and approachable he talked us through the options and wasn’t pushy at all. Installation went smoothly. Very happy with our solar system.

Empower Solar did a fantastic job providing quotes, installing and following up on the connection of our 6.66kW, 3-phase, east-west solar system.Michael Wang was our sales consultant and he provided me with plentiful options and information over a good couple of months before we were ready to push the button and go for the install (full disclosure - I've briefly worked with Michael in a professional capacity many years ago). The Huawei inverter and Longi solar panels both looked like a solid, reliable, mid-tier option for us. And the price was very reasonable.I wasn't onsite for the install (the house was being renovated at the time) but, I spoke with the installer a couple of times to clarify panel alignment and inverter position. I found the installer to be very professional and efficient, and the install looks great - even given a slightly unusual panel layout (note to self - have less vents, aerials, etc on the roof of our next house!). All the grid connection applications were taken care of by Empower.Later, once we moved into the house, I had to connect the inverter to the internet and setup the FusionSolar app. I spoke with Blessy, from Empower, and she was very helpful in getting the app and metering working.The system has been running on our house for about 4 months now. In that time, we have received our first, full two-month account. Running over Spring of 2021, we covered half our consumption with solar, and the credit from the solar exports covered half of our remaining useage charges. Working backwards from our total solar output and our total exports, i estimate our $135 bill would have been $328 without solar. Great success!Overall, we couldn't have been happier with the result and we will definitely be speaking to Empower solar when we look at our next system.

The first thing that struck me about Empower Solar Perth was that Michael was well prepared.We spoke on the phone, discussed a few details, he'd read the details I had entered into Solar Quotes website the day before so he already had an idea of what I had in mind and emailed me a quote, all before his first site visit.Michael was more than happy to discuss options and answer my questions.Over the course of a few days and a few what if's and how about's we ended up with 3 or 4 options before settling on our final configuration.Once we had settled on a configuration and payed the deposit Empower Solar Perth got the ball rolling, quickly sorting out the approvals required and arranging an installation date.I would suggest that the system we settled on was larger and somewhat more involved that your average.With that in mind I was made aware that the installation would take 2 days, weather not withstanding.The installation team was friendly, efficient and punctual.They arrived when they said they would and finished on time, tidied up after themselves, answered my questions and were happy to fuss the dog.They were happy to discussed the positioning of the inverters and battery etc so as to allow for possible future expansion.I couldn't have asked for more.Michael followed up the day after the installation was complete, making sure we didn't have any issues, checked and photographed the finished installation and took me through the monitoring software.I've included a couple of the photos Michael took with the help of a drone.All in all I'm more than happy to recommend Empower Solar Perth.Thank you Michael and the team your efforts are appreciated.

I spoke to a number of companies before deciding on Empire to install our LG 6.6kW system. I found some other companies were pushy with sales tactics, or not really listening to what we were after. Daniel took the time to talk through the options and was honest about what we needed. Installation was quick and looks great and the team left everything very neat and tidy. Daniel organised our meter reconfiguration via Powershop/Ausgrid, too. Excited to start using our new system.

I took a long time to decide between a couple of major options from two different installers...  basically a Fronius/BYD solution or the Huawei/Huawei solution from Empower Solar that I ended up choosing.  The Huawei solution was a bit larger with greater scope for expandability (for example by adding an extra battery etc).  I felt I took a slight risk with the somewhat unknown Aleo panels but they came with a 25yr warranty and had good specifications and seem to be performing well so far.Throughout the pre-sales process I really got the feeling that Empower wanted to find an optimum solution for my unique circumstances.  Special thanks must go to Michael Wang from Empower who was particularly helpful.The installers mounted the inverters and battery very neatly and discussed with me at length the ideal orientation of the panels on the roof.We will see over time how well the system performs and, if/when it breaks down, how quickly Empower can help to resolve the problems.So far, so good...  I'm pleased with the performance and hope that continues for a long time to come because it'll take a good few years to repay the investment :-)

Extremely impressed by Empower from the moment we contacted them for a quote, to the install. Didn't harass us for a response, and were patient and polite in explaining the different options. Organised the grid connection promptly. All the technicians who attended on the day were professional, friendly, and punctual. Would certainly recommend Empower, just as they were recommended to us.

Michael was the sales person from Empower that we dealt with. He was professional and was happy to come our place to discuss the quote. He reduced price slightly when we asked so we were very happy.The installation was quick and installers arrived on time. The team had to remove our old system first and did a great job. They cleaned up all the residue afterwards so we’re very pleased with that too.Empower did all the paperwork regarding connecting to the grid as this was a replacement solar power system for us at this house.

Excellent and flawless from start to finish, commencing with the Consultant Daniel who was very knowledgeable and  easy to speak with, which helped make our selection very easy and without any pressure.The installation could not have gone any better. The workers arrived on time as scheduled, were very polite and tidy.The whole process from start to finish was handled very professionally and smoothly by Empower Solar Perth.Although it is still early to see our power bill savings, we are certain we made the correct decision to put solar panels and 'definately' chose the right company to install them.We highly recommend Empower Solar Perth to anyone thinking of going solar.

LOOK NO FURTHER!I was initially looking at the iStore HWS - the pricing post the STC rebate were coming in just under $3k through a plumber and also having to source my own electrician drove the price up.Feeling put off I started to look at Solar upgrade due to already having a system for 11 years and zero bills I wanted to maintain my bills at a low on no cost, due to the higher feed in tariff ending.I came across several options and I can tell you some of them are very pushy to sell their products over the phone, being a bit old school I wanted a more professional approach for my custom, I then found that Empower Solar had the package for me with the 6.6kW System and the 180L iStore,  the price was amazing and everything included.Very professional sales rep, no pressure to sign up - explained everything.  Logan is very knowledgable, his approach was on point - he’s a credit to your establishment.  I’ll be in touch again once the rebates are available for the batteries.On the day of install everything went like clockwork, Mike and Jake were a pleasure to have on site - even answering a few more questions during the install,  plumbers and commissioning electricians all notified me of their attendance prior to showing up.Can’t ask for more to be honest!They even removed my old system which gave me the chance to ‘Pay it Forward’ to a family that couldn’t afford to get solar.Professional is an understatement.Thankyou again Empower Solar Perth!Such an easy decision.

Sales Rep did his job well, installation was excellent clean the site after,explained the system well, customer service excellent also, now just waiting for all to happen with the system ready to go Thanks Guys see you at the Canning Vale office to have a look around  Jan and Reston

The sales rep, Logan, was not pushy, showed us several options and let us decide what we needed.The system was installed efficiently within 2 weeks of the deposit being taken, and accommodated us by coming on my WFH day, the team were polite, and the leader, Austen, answered all the questions I had with respect to the specific system, and suggested future enhancements (battery) when prices were cheaper for that source.The only negative comments I have are nothing to do with Empower, and that would be that the Huawei application isn't the greatest - it will display the information you need, but it's a bit clunky, and that Western Power don't provide an app for monitoring the power generated to the grid and power pulled from the grid, which would assist us in changing our routines to get the most advantage from our solar installation.
Outstanding service from Michael Wang and the installation crew was also tops.
Excellent customer service able to work with my movements to meet and review the quoted system

We received a couple of quotes which were only a few dollars apart. What impressed us with Empower was the actual installers came around to assess the house before finalizing the quote. Gave me confidence that we wouldn’t get any surprises.On the day the installation went smoothly and they cleaned up and left the place tidy.Would have no hesitation in recommending Empower.

The initial enquiry was informative and gaveme the info I needed without the hard sell. They took care of all the paperwork and meter change with Western Power, hassle free.When it came to the install it was quality workmanship and service and they cleaned up after finishing. Very pleased with our decision to use Empower Solar, I’d highly recommend them.

Excellent product and install. The Huawei Inverter and app work great! Very happy. Only thing I wasn’t 100% happy with was the clean up, there were bunches of small metal shards left on our driveway. Our 4 yr old runs bare foot up and down the driveway. Maybe lay a sheet down to collect those bits for future jobs.

Anthony Lentini was recommended to me by his previous client. Anthony was an excellent Sales Consultant , patiently explaining to me the technical specifications and end to end process of the installation on what to expect.The proposal and pricing provided to me was fair.I was fortunate my installation was brought forward, the installers were punctual and professionals. They explained clearly what is going to be done etc. It was a clean job, and no mess was left behind.

Very happy with the whole process from sourcing to completion of installation. Received invitation to visit Empower’s warehouse after first enquiry, and the salesperson was very knowledgeable and professional in his presentation.Quote was reasonable for a 6.6kwSma/18panels Longi system they do not put a high price then offer to price match like some others.Installation was smooth the guys started and finished on time, took around 5 hours as estimated.After sales service was good I had a couple of enquiries and the salesperson replied promptly.The system has been running almost two months now without problems and generating close to maximum capacity .Very happy and would recommend Empower for sure .

We were very happy with the purchasing and installation process. Very professionally presented and installed and all in a short time. The process was simple and they arranged everything. We were able to select our install date.Its now been installed over a full year and the performace has been outstanding.During Summer it generates over 40kwh per day.We saved over $1400 in the first full annual billing cycle. Based on that it will pay for itself in under 3 years.That is actually better than Empower proposed.Very Happy

We were very happy with Empower Solar after having the company recommended to us by a friend. Zenzo was very informative and helpful answering our questions through the enquiry process and we were confident we were purchasing reputable and effective brands/products.The installation was quick and thorough and the team showed us how the system and app worked. We can’t wait to save money and the environment over the coming years. Thanks Empower Solar
Everything has gone well. We loved the upfront chat about financing this system.
Sales rep was very passionate and informative. The installation was tidy and professional - they even fit us in a week early. Very easy process all round.

On 12th November 2020, Empower installed my new replacement system. They were not the cheapest quote nor the most expensive; but they were the ones that gave me the most confidence I was going to receive a good system and ongoing support as needed. Michael in particular has been very helpful through the process. I would definitely recommend Empower Solar.

The salesperson was informed, knew their products, listened to what I wanted then gave me a number of options in written quotes. Very easy to deal withThe installation team arrived on time and after a short conversation with me about location of the inverter, got straight to work. They were efficient, worked in a safe manner and were always polite. The job was completed in under 3 hours.Customer service was faultless.I highly recommend ESP to anyone looking to install solar power.
